postContent: I retired exactly one year ago today and haven't looked back. Today, I made and canned salsa from garden tomatoes, took a fall foliage bike ride, picked up my granddaughter from school, and spent time with my 18 month old grandson. Tomorrow we're going apple picking. Sunday we may bike ride, kayak, or do nothing at all. It is truly epic.
